pricing.details: Self-serve per workspace, billed monthly — 60,000 credits 90 €/month; 120,000 credits 171 €/month; 240,000 credits 325 €/month; 480,000 credits 614 €/month; 960,000 credits 1,175 €/month. 7-day trial with 30,000 free credits (card required to start the trial). One sending account included, each extra account 35 €/month. White Glove 2,714 €/month (3-month initial commitment, then month to month). Enterprise custom.
